proxy.title: Upstream proxy
proxy.description: Route outbound requests to upstream providers through an HTTP/HTTPS or SOCKS5 proxy. Precedence: account > provider > global > environment.

global.label: Global proxy
global.description: Applies to every upstream unless a provider or account override is set.

audit.title: Request audit log
audit.description: Record a per-request audit entry (who, from where, when, which model, status, latency). Opt-in and off by default; the store is admin-only, retained for a configurable window, then pruned. Writes are fire-and-forget and never affect relay latency.

enable.label: Enable audit log
enable.description: Master switch. When off, nothing is captured (zero regression).

captureBodies.label: Capture request/response bodies
captureBodies.description: A separate, sensitive opt-in. Bodies are truncated and passed through a secret-redaction pass; request headers are never captured. Streaming responses record metadata only.

retentionDays.label: Retention (days)
retentionDays.description: Audit files older than this are pruned (whole-file delete).

trustForwardedFor.label: Trust X-Forwarded-For
trustForwardedFor.description: Use the X-Forwarded-For header for the client IP. Enable ONLY behind a trusted reverse proxy — a client-supplied header is never trusted otherwise.

viewer.title: Audit log viewer
viewer.hint: Refresh to load recent audit records.

fingerprint.title: Client fingerprint
fingerprint.description: Present a stable, real per-account client identity on relayed Claude subscription traffic so it blends with a genuine Claude Code client. Fingerprint headers (x-stainless-*, user-agent, anthropic-beta) are captured from real client requests, frozen per account, and replayed — never fabricated. Off by default; when off, outbound headers are unchanged. Takes effect on restart.

enable.label: Enable fingerprint replay
enable.description: Master switch. When off, no headers are captured or replayed (zero regression).

ua.label: User-Agent baseline
ua.description: Optional. Applied only to an account with no captured identity yet (never a fabricated stainless header). Leave blank to send today's headers until a real client is captured.

voucher.title: Redemption cards
voucher.description: Generate redeemable cards that top up an outbound key's spend limit (credit) or extend its expiry (renewal). A key-holder redeems a card against their own key; you generate and revoke. Codes are shown once and stored only as a hash. Off by default.

enable.label: Enable redemption cards
enable.description: Master switch. When off, the redeem endpoint is inert and no card mutates any key (zero regression).

voucher.disabledHint: Enable the feature to generate cards.

created.title: Card generated
created.warning: Copy this code now — it is shown only once and cannot be retrieved later.

voucher.revokeConfirmDesc: Card {{prefix}}… will no longer be redeemable. This cannot be undone.

redeemInfo.title: How holders redeem
redeemInfo.description: A key-holder redeems a card against their own outbound key on the API server, authenticated by their key:

billing.title: Billing event stream
billing.description: Emit a structured billing event per billable request for an external consumer (a metering service, data warehouse, or billing platform). Durable-first: each event is written to a local ledger before delivery, so a failed POST never loses a billing record. Off by default; publishing never affects relay latency.

enable.label: Enable billing stream
enable.description: Master switch. When off, nothing is published (zero regression).

endpoint.label: Delivery endpoint
endpoint.description: POST target for each event. Leave blank for ledger-only mode — events are durably recorded and an external tailer consumes the ledger directly.

secret.label: HMAC secret
secret.description: Optional signing key. When set, each POST carries an X-Omnicross-Billing-Signature header. Stored encrypted and masked; it only signs and never travels in the event payload.

maxRetryAge.label: Max retry age (hours)
maxRetryAge.description: Undelivered events are retried up to this age, then retained in the ledger for reconciliation — never deleted.

status.title: Delivery status
status.hint: Refresh to load the ledger's delivery counts.

webhook.title: Webhook notifications
webhook.description: Deliver operational events (account recovery/anomaly, key quota, server errors) to a URL out-of-band. Delivery is fire-and-forget and never affects relay latency.

enable.label: Enable webhooks
enable.description: Master switch. When off, no events are delivered.
